entries.en: Added `"defer"` permission decision to `PreToolUse` hooks — headless sessions can pause at a tool call and resume with `-p --resume` to have the hook re-evaluate
entries.zh: 向`PreToolUse`挂钩添加了“defer”权限决策 - 无头会话可以在工具调用时暂停，并使用`-p --resume`恢复以使挂钩重新评估

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1` environment variable to opt into flicker-free alt-screen rendering with virtualized scrollback
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1`环境变量以选择具有虚拟回滚功能的无闪烁替代屏幕渲染

entries.en: Added `PermissionDenied` hook that fires after auto mode classifier denials — return `{retry: true}` to tell the model it can retry
entries.zh: 添加了`PermissionDenied`钩子，该钩子在自动模式分类器拒绝后触发 - 返回`{retry: true}`以告诉模型它可以重试

entries.en: Added named subagents to `@` mention typeahead suggestions
entries.zh: 将命名子代理添加到`@`提及提前输入建议

entries.en: Added `MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true` for `-p` mode to skip the MCP connection wait entirely, and bounded `--mcp-config` server connections at 5s instead of blocking on the slowest server
entries.zh: 为`-p`模式添加了`MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true`，以完全跳过 MCP 连接等待，并将`--mcp-config`服务器连接限制在 5 秒，而不是在最慢的服务器上阻塞

entries.en: Auto mode: denied commands now show a notification and appear in `/permissions` → Recent tab where you can retry with `r`
entries.zh: 自动模式：被拒绝的命令现在显示通知并出现在`/permissions`→“最近”选项卡中，您可以在其中使用`r`重试

entries.en: `/buddy` is here for April 1st — hatch a small creature that watches you code
entries.zh: `/buddy` 为 4 月 1 日愚人节上线：孵化一只会看着你写代码的小生物

entries.en: Improved collapsed tool summary to show "Listed N directories" for `ls`/`tree`/`du` instead of "Read N files"
entries.zh: 改进折叠的工具摘要：对 `ls`/`tree`/`du` 显示“Listed N directories”（列出了 N 个目录），而不是“Read N files”

entries.en: Improved Bash tool to warn when a formatter/linter command modifies files you have previously read, preventing stale-edit errors
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 工具：格式化或代码检查命令修改了你之前读过的文件时发出警告，避免“过期编辑”错误

entries.en: Improved `@`-mention typeahead to rank source files above MCP resources with similar names
entries.zh: 改进 `@` 提及的输入提示：源代码文件排在名称相近的 MCP 资源之前

entries.en: Improved PowerShell tool prompt with version-appropriate syntax guidance (5.1 vs 7+)
entries.zh: 改进 PowerShell 工具提示：按版本给出对应的语法指导（5.1 与 7+ 不同）

entries.en: Changed `Edit` to work on files viewed via `Bash` with `sed -n` or `cat`, without requiring a separate `Read` call first
entries.zh: 更改了`Edit`以处理通过`Bash`使用`sed -n`或`cat`查看的文件，而不需要先单独调用`Read`

entries.en: Changed hook output over 10,000 characters to be saved to disk with a file path + a 2,000-character preview instead of being injected directly into context
entries.zh: 更改了超过 10,000 个字符的挂钩输出，以使用文件路径 + 2,000 个字符的预览保存到磁盘，而不是直接注入到上下文中

entries.en: Changed `cleanupPeriodDays: 0` in settings.json to be rejected with a validation error — it previously silently disabled transcript persistence
entries.zh: 将 settings.json 中的 `cleanupPeriodDays: 0` 更改为因验证错误而被拒绝 - 它之前默默地禁用了转录持久性

entries.en: Changed thinking summaries to no longer be generated by default in interactive sessions — set `showThinkingSummaries: true` in settings.json to restore
entries.zh: 更改了交互式会话中默认情况下不再生成的思维摘要 - 在 settings.json 中设置 `showThinkingSummaries: true` 来恢复

entries.en: PowerShell tool on Windows: external-command arguments containing both a double-quote and whitespace now prompt instead of auto-allowing (PS 5.1 argument-splitting hardening)
entries.zh: Windows 上的 PowerShell 工具：外部命令参数中同时含双引号和空白字符时，现在会提示确认，而不是自动放行（PS 5.1 参数拆分加固）

entries.en: `/env` now applies to PowerShell tool commands (previously only affected Bash)
entries.zh: `/env` 现在对 PowerShell 工具命令也生效（此前只影响 Bash）

entries.en: `/usage` now hides redundant "Current week (Sonnet only)" bar for Pro and Enterprise plans
entries.zh: `/usage` 现在会对 Pro 和 Enterprise 套餐隐藏多余的 "Current week (Sonnet only)" 进度条

entries.en: Pasting `!command` into an empty prompt now enters bash mode, matching typed `!` behavior
entries.zh: 在空提示中粘贴 `!command` 现在会进入 bash 模式，与手动输入 `!` 的效果一致

entries.en: Fixed `Edit(//path/**)` and `Read(//path/**)` allow rules to check the resolved symlink target, not just the requested path
entries.zh: 修复了 `Edit(//path/**)` 和 `Read(//path/**)` 允许规则检查解析的符号链接目标，而不仅仅是请求的路径

entries.en: Fixed voice push-to-talk not activating for some modifier-combo bindings, and voice mode on Windows failing with "WebSocket upgrade rejected with HTTP 101"
entries.zh: 修复部分修饰键组合的语音一键通话绑定无法激活的问题，以及 Windows 上语音模式报"WebSocket upgrade rejected with HTTP 101"而失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed Edit/Write tools doubling CRLF on Windows and stripping Markdown hard line breaks (two trailing spaces)
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的编辑/写入工具加倍 CRLF 并剥离 Markdown 硬换行符（两个尾随空格）

entries.en: Fixed `StructuredOutput` schema cache bug causing ~50% failure rate when using multiple schemas
entries.zh: 修复了使用多个模式时导致约 50% 失败率的`StructuredOutput`模式缓存错误

entries.en: Fixed memory leak where large JSON inputs were retained as LRU cache keys in long-running sessions
entries.zh: 修复了内存泄漏，其中大型 JSON 输入在长时间运行的会话中保留为 LRU 缓存键

entries.en: Fixed a crash when removing a message from very large session files (over 50MB)
entries.zh: 修复了从非常大的会话文件（超过 50MB）中删除消息时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed LSP server zombie state after crash — server now restarts on next request instead of failing until session restart
entries.zh: 修复了崩溃后 LSP 服务器僵尸状态 — 服务器现在在下一个请求时重新启动，而不是在会话重新启动之前失败

entries.en: Fixed prompt history entries containing CJK or emoji being silently dropped when they fall on a 4KB boundary in `~/.claude/history.jsonl`
entries.zh: 修复了包含 CJK 或表情符号的提示历史条目在落在 `~/.claude/history.jsonl` 中的 4KB 边界上时被静默删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/stats` undercounting tokens by excluding subagent usage, and losing historical data beyond 30 days when the stats cache format changes
entries.zh: 修复了`/stats`通过排除子代理使用而低估令牌的问题，并在统计缓存格式更改时丢失超过 30 天的历史数据

entries.en: Fixed `-p --resume` hangs when the deferred tool input exceeds 64KB or no deferred marker exists, and `-p --continue` not resuming deferred tools
entries.zh: 修复了当延迟工具输入超过 64KB 或不存在延迟标记时`-p --resume`挂起，以及`-p --continue`不恢复延迟工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude-cli://` deep links not opening on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了`claude-cli://`深层链接无法在 macOS 上打开的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool errors truncating to only the first content block when the server returns multi-element error content
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器返回多元素错误内容时 MCP 工具错误仅截断为第一个内容块的问题

entries.en: Fixed skill reminders and other system context being dropped when sending messages with images via the SDK
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SDK 发送带有图像的消息时技能提醒和其他系统上下文被删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks to receive `file_path` as an absolute path for Write/Edit/Read tools, matching the documented behavior
entries.zh: 修复了 PreToolUse/PostToolUse 挂钩以接收`file_path`作为写入/编辑/读取工具的绝对路径，与记录的行为相匹配

entries.en: Fixed autocompact thrash loop — now detects when context refills to the limit immediately after compacting three times in a row and stops with an actionable error instead of burning API calls
entries.zh: 修复了 autocompact thrash 循环 - 现在检测连续压缩 3 次后上下文何时重新填充到限制，并以可操作的错误停止，而不是烧毁 API 调用

entries.en: Fixed prompt cache misses in long sessions caused by tool schema bytes changing mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了由于工具模式字节在会话中更改而导致长会话中的提示缓存丢失

entries.en: Fixed nested CLAUDE.md files being re-injected dozens of times in long sessions that read many files
entries.zh: 修复了在读取许多文件的长会话中嵌套的 CLAUDE.md 文件被重新注入数十次的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` crash when transcript contains a tool result from an older CLI version or interrupted write
entries.zh: 修复了当脚本包含旧 CLI 版本或中断写入的工具结果时`--resume`崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed misleading "Rate limit reached" message when the API returned an entitlement error — now shows the actual error with actionable hints
entries.zh: 修复了 API 返回授权错误时误导性的“已达到速率限制”消息 — 现在显示带有可操作提示的实际错误

entries.en: Fixed hooks `if` condition filtering not matching compound commands (`ls && git push`) or commands with env-var prefixes (`FOO=bar git push`)
entries.zh: 修复了钩子`if`条件过滤与复合命令（`ls && git push`）或带有 env-var 前缀的命令（`FOO=bar git push`）不匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed collapsed search/read group badges duplicating in terminal scrollback during heavy parallel tool use
entries.zh: 修复了在大量并行工具使用期间折叠搜索/读取组徽章在终端回滚中重复的问题

entries.en: Fixed notification `invalidates` not clearing the currently-displayed notification immediately
entries.zh: 修复了通知“无效”未立即清除当前显示的通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt briefly disappearing after submit when background messages arrived during processing
entries.zh: 修复了处理过程中后台消息到达时提交后提示短暂消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed Devanagari and other combining-mark text being truncated in assistant output
entries.zh: 修复了梵文和其他组合标记文本在助理输出中被截断的问题

entries.en: Fixed rendering artifacts on main-screen terminals after layout shifts
entries.zh: 修复了布局变化后主屏幕终端上的渲染伪影

entries.en: Fixed voice mode failing to request microphone permission on macOS Apple Silicon
entries.zh: 修复 macOS Apple Silicon 上语音模式无法请求麦克风权限的问题

entries.en: Fixed Shift+Enter submitting instead of inserting a newline on Windows Terminal Preview 1.25
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows Terminal Preview 1.25 上 Shift+Enter 提交而不是插入换行符的问题

entries.en: Fixed periodic UI jitter during streaming in iTerm2 when running inside tmux
entries.zh: 修复了在 tmux 内运行时在 iTerm2 中进行流传输期间的周期性 UI 抖动

entries.en: Fixed PowerShell tool incorrectly reporting failures when commands like `git push` wrote progress to stderr on Windows PowerShell 5.1
entries.zh: 修复了当`git push`等命令在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 上将进度写入 stderr 时 PowerShell 工具错误报告失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed a potential out-of-memory crash when the Edit tool was used on very large files (>1 GiB)
entries.zh: 修复了在非常大的文件 (>1 GiB) 上使用编辑工具时可能出现的内存不足崩溃问题

entries.en: Preserved task notifications when backgrounding a running command with Ctrl+B
entries.zh: 用 Ctrl+B 把正在运行的命令转入后台时，保留任务通知

entries.en: Image paste no longer inserts a trailing space
entries.zh: 粘贴图片后不再多出一个末尾空格

entries.en: Documented `TaskCreated` hook event and its blocking behavior
entries.zh: 记录了`TaskCreated`挂钩事件及其阻塞行为
